text:
maria_support: Received ticket from AcmeCorp SRE. They say SSO logins started failing immediately after IdP rotated signing certs. Error: "Assertion recipient mismatch" on our side. Customer attached SAMLResponse (base64) and new IdP metadata URL. Repro steps below.

 dan_oncall: thanks. can you paste the original ACS they hit and the SP EntityID we advertise?

 maria_support: ACS they show: https://app.redwood.ai/saml/acs (customer observed redirect to https://app.redwood.ai/saml/acs/ at one point). SP EntityID: https://redwood.ai/saml/metadata

 kyle_engineering: quick checklist: trailing slash differences, RelayState encoding, and cert/keyDescriptor ordering can all bite us after rotations. also check Signature algorithm in new metadata (sha1 vs sha256).

 maria_support: customer says IdP metadata endpoint: https://acme-idp.example/metadata.xml (they updated cert 22:10 UTC). they confirm they rotated only signing key, not encryption.

 kyle_engineering: fetched metadata and decoded locally, saw two <KeyDescriptor use="signing"> entries. order changed (old key first, new key second). our metadata parser picks the first valid signing key for verification which can fail if IdP signs with second. snippet:

 ```
 <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
   <KeyInfo>...old-thumbprint...</KeyInfo>
 </KeyDescriptor>
 <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
   <KeyInfo>...new-thumbprint...</KeyInfo>
 </KeyDescriptor>
 ```

 kyle_engineering: that explains intermittent failures. also their SAMLResponse has Recipient="https://app.redwood.ai/saml/acs" but the Assertion's SubjectConfirmationData Recipient was url with trailing slash. our assertion check is strict.

 maria_support: reproduced with a sample response they sent (decoded):

 ```
 <!-- decoded SAMLResponse -->
 <Assertion>
   <SubjectConfirmation>
     <SubjectConfirmationData Recipient="https://app.redwood.ai/saml/acs/" InResponseTo="_abc" />
   </SubjectConfirmation>
 </Assertion>
 ```

 dan_oncall: so two issues: (1) verification key selection ordering, (2) ACS URL canonicalization. mitigation steps:
 - ask IdP to reorder metadata so signing key appears first OR have them sign with the first key (temporary)
 - enable relaxed ACS matching for AcmeCorp (allow trailing slash) while we push a parser fix
 - ask customer to re-upload metadata to their side after we publish SP metadata with both ACS forms? (not ideal)

 kyle_engineering: quick patch: modify SAML validation to iterate over all <KeyDescriptor use="signing"> and try verify against each key rather than only first. low-risk hotfix; I can push to staging.

 maria_support: customer wants ETA, they're blocked from SSO logins for new hires. can we estimate?

 kyle_engineering: I can produce a staging build in ~2h, need sign-off from security on new key verification loop. rolling deploy to production maybe EOD if security ok and tests pass.

 ops-triage: created incident ticket INC-4729 and linked to the support case. tagging sec-review.

 saml-bot: Incident INC-4729 created by ops-triage • Priority: P2 • Assigned: kyle_engineering

 maria_support: also flagged potential duplicate: their metadata uses SignatureMethod RSA-SHA1 in one <Signature> node. if they can reconfigure to RSA-SHA256 it will be more future-proof.

 kyle_engineering: noted. in parallel I'll add an ACS canonicalization check that strips trailing slash and normalizes encoding on our side for the assertion Recipient/ACS check, limited to this tenant until we roll global change.

 dan_oncall: next actions for support thread:
 - maria_support: ask customer for freshly fetched metadata URL and a signed SAMLResponse sample with timestamp within last 10 minutes if possible
 - maria_support: ask them to attempt login while we watch logs
 - kyle_engineering: will cut staging PR for multi-key verification and ACS normalization flag
 - ops-triage: keep incident open and update SLA timeline

 maria_support: pinged AcmeCorp for the new artifacts and requested a live repro window tomorrow 10:00 UTC. shared suggested temporary workarounds with them (re-sign using preferred key or re-order metadata). they acknowledged :thumbsup: 

 kyle_engineering: will post the PR link here once ready. also adding unit test that simulates metadata with reversed key order and Assertion Recipient variations.

 maria_support: thanks all, marking support case as escalated and waiting on customer repro window. will update thread when they reply.
